events.text: Drašković served as the Deputy Prime Minister of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia.
events.subject: self
events.object: Deputy Prime Minister of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia
events.quote: served as the Deputy Prime Minister of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia in 1999

events.text: Drašković became Minister of Foreign Affairs of both Serbia and Montenegro and Serbia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Minister of Foreign Affairs of both Serbia and Montenegro and Serbia from 2006 to 2007

events.text: Drašković's term as Minister of Foreign Affairs ended.
events.subject: self

events.text: Drašković graduated from the University of Belgrade Faculty of Law.
events.subject: self
events.object: University of Belgrade Faculty of Law
events.quote: He graduated from the University of Belgrade Faculty of Law in 1968

events.text: Drašković began working as a journalist in the Yugoslav news agency Tanjug.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From 1969-80 he worked as a journalist in the Yugoslav news agency Tanjug

events.text: Drašković's work as a journalist in Tanjug ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From 1969-80 he worked as a journalist in the Yugoslav news agency Tanjug
